items.title: 特权进程先校验路径再执行 cp/mv/rm，共享存储存在跨 App TOCTOU
softwareChanges: Replaced post-check external cp/mv/rm execution with the shared typed DeviceFileOperations orchestrator and Android directory-descriptor adapter.

Every user child is NOFOLLOW; directory device/inode/type and parent descriptor location are checked. File opening precedes fstat/regular-file/hard-link checks and truncation. Recursive operations retain descriptors and recheck each object. Known unsafe batches are rejected before earlier deletions.

ADB FILE dispatch invokes the current installed APK DeviceFileCore under UID0/2000; current package UID/source classpath is checked through existing PrivilegedPackageContext, arguments stay argv data, and failures/unknown results never replay old shell commands.

New-file create is exclusive; same-source/descendant copy is rejected; cp -p, mkdir -p, touch -c, rm -d/-f, cancellation and no-clobber are explicit. mv -n uses exclusive hard-link publication for regular files; unsupported mounts/directories fail safely without copying/deleting fallback.
Added a keep rule for the app_process main entry.
